description: This file defines a utility function to create payload objects from raw server items, distinguishing between deleted and content payloads, and importing relevant interfaces and classes from the '@standardnotes/models' package.

methods.name: export function CreatePayloadFromRawServerItem( CreatePayloadFromRawServerItem
methods.description: Creates and returns an appropriate payload object (EncryptedPayloadInterface or DeletedPayloadInterface) based on the input raw server item, detecting if the item is deleted or contains content.
